category: multi-hoster (Polish; daily transfer limit on a time account)

free_tier.stated: unverified: the pricing page ties the daily Premium Limit to a purchase; no free allowance is stated on it
free_tier.notes: The registration page of the same operator lists the daily limit among the advantages of registering, which does not say whether it applies before a purchase.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-file cap is stated on the pricing page

egress.terms: 20GB / 24H Premium Limit credited daily at midnight; unused transfer accumulates up to 80GB. Extra transfer packs are sold separately.

interface_detail: Web account panel; the same operator's family of sites uses one template.
tooling: Browser; JDownloader and pyLoad support is claimed only by third-party lists.
chaining: Sibling sites of one operator at different daily limits: tb7.pl (10GB), xt7.pl (20GB), gb7.pl (50GB).
binding_note: The daily Premium Limit in bytes is the stated cap; accumulation raises the ceiling on a single day.

identity_cost.detail: A registration page and a login exist; payment by BLIK, e-transfer or card is listed. The form fields were not rendered, so the email requirement is unverified.

reliability_note: No outage observed on the day read.
confidence_note: First-party pricing page read once; prices in zloty.
